coverage.related_pre_history: V50-V54 are a separate ELM/byte task line, not native MiniFly evidence
coverage.scope: Existing contracts, implementations, reports, current pointers and complete overlapping mechanism-review views. No new scientific execution.

counting_policy.reason: Nodes mix distinct dimensions and overlap. They are not a count of independent unauthorized experiments, invalid reports, or failed mechanism families.

events.title: Reusable learning narrowed to retention of taught associations
events.finding: Historical audit explicitly identifies the contraction; BYTE-CORE-1 wording and all-pair tasks are manifestations of this continuous episode.
events.authorization_boundary: Association diagnostics were legitimate; promotion to general reusable learning was not supported.

events.title: Independent routes have an unresolved capability-integration boundary
events.finding: V9.2 predictive branch does not drive native value memory. Later CONTENT recall and FE0 relation qualifications are separate configurations.
events.authorization_boundary: Reports directly establish route separation and disclose it. They do not by themselves prove a particular later misleading oral claim. This is a required integration/attribution boundary, not a separately counted proven false report.
events.finding_scope: Direct architectural fact plus a conditional cross-report attribution risk.

events.title: Native Full151 became an independent residual learner and then COV-R
events.finding: Native nine-store addition was actually tested. Residual replaces native update/readout; later COV-R has 31 weights and a 31x31 matrix, no native fast/slow/adapt operative state.
events.authorization_boundary: Structural changes were authorized. They require explicit replacement/inheritance claims rather than being narrated as unchanged native-core improvements.

events.title: Engineered priors restrict what can be inherited into a raw-byte rule-discovery claim
events.finding: Role/magnitude inputs, additive separable model and ordinal output simplify addition. Later ASCII magnitudes and decimal auxiliary machinery persist until RAW-RULE explicitly withdraws them.
events.authorization_boundary: These priors were disclosed and not all were forbidden when tested. Their results do not establish the later stricter raw-byte objective.
events.finding_scope: Priors are directly observed and disclosed in the original reports. The criticism concerns subsequent cross-version capability inheritance and interpretation, not an allegation that all original designs claimed unstructured discovery.

events.title: Noise handling became the main research question
events.finding: Next-step review prioritizes uncertainty-aware handling of wrong answers under BLURRY; successive support/restoration recipes stay on the engineered addition learner.
events.authorization_boundary: Noisy/missing answers were initially authorized. The drift was priority relative to general arithmetic, and the user later explicitly corrected it.

events.title: Entering the core meant adopting a separate development package, with no subsequent integration
events.finding: User adopted COV-SUPPORT, preserving negative scientific gate. Registry promised COV-SUPPORT/COV-R comparisons, but generic-byte work uses a different baseline and no support migration.
events.authorization_boundary: User adoption is valid and not gate tampering. Failure is ambiguous core identity and missing migration/comparison contract; not a requirement to force an incompatible scalar learner into the byte task.

events.title: A generic IO interface was implemented as a new hashed plastic bank
events.finding: 4096x257 categorical bank with 16 active contacts, no idle decay, is an engineered E0/E1 reference rather than Full151 or converted COV-SUPPORT.
events.authorization_boundary: Arbitrary byte IO was user-requested and the report explicitly scopes the new reference. It cannot carry prior native-memory or arithmetic evidence into later experiments.

events.title: Based on the old core changed meaning and did not preserve an old baseline
events.finding: V3 changes GRU equations, initialization, head geometry, optimizer, precision, credit and dose simultaneously. SOURCE-CELL then chooses a separate old ELM mother; Full151 is historical timing/storage reference only.
events.authorization_boundary: Model changes and two branches were authorized; misleading continuity and lack of controlled reference are the issue. No evidence operative ELM persisted after its user veto.

events.title: Performance and completion compared across different budgets and evidence stages
events.finding: Old repeated addition, arbitrary-key memory and current mixed arithmetic have different exposure/dose and priors. Technical qualification does not establish scientific generalization; idle time without parameter evolution is not native consolidation.
events.authorization_boundary: Recent reports often state these limits correctly. Interpretations such as the same core lost its intelligence or all tested families failed are not supported.

events.title: Mechanism aliases mixed different actual operations
events.finding: Historical U042 independent write/forget gates differs from SUPPORT; historical U034 Bayes reopening differs from SUPPORT-DIR; U055 was wrongly assigned joint reestimation and later explicitly corrected.
events.authorization_boundary: Latest complete review separates them and records no new family-wide scientific exclusion. Some old entry views remain inconsistent; do not invalidate all negative evidence.

preserved_findings: Native Full151 has limited delayed E3 in V9.9A and V9.9B; not all native work is exact lookup.
Original addition did include a nine-store native Full151 comparison; its failure does not exclude the entire family.
COV-R has valid engineered bounded-addition evidence; it is not operative Full151.
COV-SUPPORT user adoption is a legitimate development decision; frozen negative advancement verdict is unchanged.
Generic-byte IO has valid bounded E0/E1 engineering evidence, not inherited arithmetic E3.
Later technical-cycle passes do not establish successful unseen four-operation generalization.
Latest full inventory review does not scientifically exclude entire mechanism families from these recipe failures.
corrections_needed: Carry executable model lineage and retained operations into every next design.
Distinguish user adoption, scientific confirmation, engineering reference and experiment candidate.
Do not merge independently qualified branches into a claimed integrated core.
Index mechanism evidence by source IDs, operation version, substrate and task rather than U alias alone.
Keep objective and resource accounting consistent without treating user-requested arithmetic or byte output as goal drift.
